svg.title: Exact FC cache misses against statistical approximations
svg.desc: Cold-call flash misses of the CMSIS-NN FC source schedule under the synthetic set-associative LRU contract, exact (Theorem A1) versus a fully associative LRU of equal capacity and the random-set-mapping model. Not an L4R5 ART claim.
svg.text: Paired-row resonance: exact misses vs. statistical models
FC flash stream, one cold call, m = 16 rows, L = 16 B lines, S = 8 sets, n swept over two S·L periods. Synthetic contract; not an L4R5 ART measurement.
